subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should ordinary exec-like failures be suppressed before mutating-tool warning handling, or should the current visible-warning safety behavior remain the default?
rationale: The branch asks for broader warning suppression, but current source and tests deliberately keep failed command warnings visible when the assistant may look successful, so automation cannot choose the product safety contract.

options.title: Keep visible mutating exec warnings
options.body: Preserve the current safety behavior and require any fix to be narrower than suppressing all exec-like detail cases.

options.title: Suppress exec-like warnings earlier
options.body: Move exec-like suppression before mutating handling and update tests to explicitly accept hiding those failed-command warnings.

recommendation.title: Keep visible mutating exec warnings
recommendation.body: Preserve the current safety behavior and require any fix to be narrower than suppressing all exec-like detail cases.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent commits and current blame point this route through the warning/mutation helper area that vincentkoc most recently maintained.
